items.title: Distant sensors announced a fearsome tsunami’s birth

items.summary_zh: Nature，在线发表于2026年9月10日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02809-6 地震数据精确定位了一座海底火山的崩塌，并揭示了喷发如何引发了一场破坏性海啸。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02809-6 Seismic data pinpoint the collapse of an underwater volcano, and reveal how the eruption triggered a destructive tsunami.

items.title: Phone tutoring boosts math scores when schools are forced to close
items.title_zh: 学校被迫关闭时，电话辅导提升数学成绩
items.summary_zh: Nature，在线发布：2026年9月9日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02843-4 证据表明，定期通话可在教育中断时保持儿童学习——此外，为何熟悉的世界地图可能即将改变。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02843-4 Evidence suggests that regular calls can keep kids learning when schooling is disrupted — plus, why a familiar world map may be about to change.

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02751-7 Learn how artificial intelligence can hone your research skills as well as the potential pitfalls of relying too heavily on it.

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02823-8 Anticancer drugs could be manufactured and delivered by modified microorganisms.

items.title: Ruins of ancient Asian city show engineering prowess and organization
items.title_zh: 古亚洲城市遗址展现工程实力与组织能力
items.summary_zh: Nature，在线发表：2026年9月9日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02821-w 拥有5000年历史的良渚古城在充满挑战的沼泽地带建造了土墩、水坝和城墙。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02821-w The 5,000-year-old city of Liangzhu has mounds, dams and city walls built in a challenging waterlogged site.

items.title: Breaking timescales with generative sampling of conformational transitions
items.title_zh: 打破构象转变生成采样的时间尺度
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11025-1 一种生成式committor引导路径采样框架，无需预定义集合变量或暴力采样，以可接受的计算成本重建稀有生物分子转变路径，并揭示其潜在热力学和动力学。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11025-1 A generative committor-guided path-sampling framework reconstructs rare biomolecular transition pathways and reveals the underlying thermodynamics and kinetics without using predefined collective variables or brute-force sampling, at an acceptable computational cost.

items.title: Within-family effect of ancestry on complex traits in a Mexican population
items.title_zh: 墨西哥人群中家族内祖先效应对复杂性状的影响
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11039-9 本研究采用家族内设计，在墨西哥城遗传多样性人群中识别出身高和2型糖尿病等复杂性状的显著祖先差异。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11039-9 This study uses a within-family design to identify significant ancestry differences in complex traits such as height and type 2 diabetes in a genetically diverse population from Mexico City.

items.title: Neocortical long-range inhibition promotes cortical synchrony and sleep
items.title_zh: 新皮层长程抑制促进皮层同步和睡眠
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10876-y 在小鼠中，新皮层中稀疏的睡眠激活长程抑制神经元促进广泛皮层同步和睡眠，揭示了一种有助于睡眠调节的皮层机制。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10876-y In mice, a sparse population of sleep-active long-range inhibitory neurons in the neocortex promote widespread cortical synchronization and sleep, revealing a cortical mechanism that contributes to the regulation of sleep.

items.title: An operational perturbation proteomics-based virtual cell model
items.title_zh: 基于操作扰动蛋白质组学的虚拟细胞模型
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11001-9 通过系统扰动的乳腺癌细胞系生成时间蛋白质丰度测量，开发了ProteinTalks，一种作为多种药物发现任务操作工具的虚拟细胞模型。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11001-9 Temporal protein-abundance measurements from systematically perturbed breast cancer cell lines were generated to develop ProteinTalks, a virtual cell model that functions as an operational tool for diverse drug discovery tasks.

items.title: PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes regulates anti-tumour immunity
items.title_zh: 肿瘤引流淋巴结中的PLA2G2D调节抗肿瘤免疫
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10954-1 肿瘤引流淋巴结中表达高水平酶PLA2G2D的特定巨噬细胞群与患者不良预后相关，抑制PLA2G2D可改善小鼠模型的抗肿瘤免疫。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10954-1 A specific population of macrophages that express high levels of the enzyme PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes is associated with poor prognosis in patients, and inhibiting PLA2G2D improves anti-tumour immunity in mouse models.

items.title: Foaming photopolymers as a high-resolution biomimetic printing platform
items.title_zh: 发泡光聚合物作为高分辨率仿生打印平台
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10968-9 深泡光刻技术利用光控聚合物发泡创建高分辨率、多功能微结构，具有可调光学、润湿和流体处理特性，适用于先进制造应用。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10968-9 Deep-foam photolithography uses light-controlled polymer foaming to create high-resolution, multifunctional microstructures with tunable optical, wetting and fluid-handling properties for advanced manufacturing applications.

items.title: Advancing conflict research and response through satellite-derived data
items.title_zh: 通过卫星衍生数据推进冲突研究和响应
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11004-6 通过改进、丰富和融合，将卫星衍生的战争破坏数据与基于文本的死亡记录整合，缓解了各来源固有局限性，揭示了超越以死亡为中心范式的复杂暴力动态，乌克兰和缅甸案例研究为例。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11004-6 Integrating satellite-derived war-damage data with text-based fatality records through improvement, enrichment and fusion mitigates limitations inherent in each source, revealing complex violence dynamics beyond fatality-centric paradigms, as case studies from Ukraine and Myanmar illustrate.

items.title: Denisovans from southwestern China and their subsistence strategies
items.title_zh: 中国西南部的丹尼索瓦人及其生存策略
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10997-4 来自蝙蝠洞的证据显示丹尼索瓦人进行专门狩猎、权宜石器生产和广泛骨骼使用，为他们在东亚的生态、行为和文化遗产提供新见解。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10997-4 Evidence from Bianfu Cave shows specialized hunting, expedient stone-tool production and extensive bone use of Denisovans, providing new insights into their ecology, behaviour and cultural legacy in eastern Asia.

items.title: A serpin–myeloid axis in pancreatic cancer heterogeneity and immune evasion
items.title_zh: 胰腺癌异质性和免疫逃逸中的丝氨酸蛋白酶抑制剂-髓系轴
items.summary_zh: Nature，2026年9月9日在线发布；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11002-8 SERPINE1和SERPINB2驱动的纤维蛋白富集生态位局部编程免疫抑制巨噬细胞并排除T细胞，实现胰腺导管癌中空间组织的免疫逃逸。

extra.description: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11002-8 SERPINE1 and SERPINB2-driven fibrin-rich niches locally programme immunosuppressive macrophages and exclude T cells, enabling spatially organized immune evasion in pancreatic ductal carcinoma.

items.title: Intend to stay, intent on the dream

items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发布：2026年9月8日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03240-5 许多人梦想在美国学习和接受科学训练。如今，这个梦想并不容易实现。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03240-5 Many have dreamt of studying and getting their scientific training in the United States. These days, that dream is no easy pursuit.

items.title: MemBrain v2: an end-to-end tool for the analysis of membranes in cryo-electron tomography
items.title_zh: MemBrain v2：用于冷冻电子断层扫描中膜分析的端到端工具
items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发布：2026年9月8日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03178-8 MemBrain v2通过提供用户友好的膜分割、膜蛋白定位和空间分析工具，实现冷冻电子断层扫描中膜的简化分析，支持跨不同数据集的工作流程。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03178-8 MemBrain v2 enables streamlined analysis of membranes in cryo-electron tomography by providing user-friendly tools for membrane segmentation, membrane protein localization and spatial analysis, supporting workflows across diverse datasets.

items.title: Reconstructing signaling histories of single cells via perturbation screens and transfer learning

items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发布：2026年9月8日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03213-8 IRIS从体外扰动数据中学习保守信号表示，以重建多样体内细胞环境中的信号状态和历史。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03213-8 IRIS learns conserved signaling representations from in vitro perturbation data to reconstruct signaling states and histories across diverse in vivo cellular contexts.

items.title: Rapid robust high-fidelity 3D neuronal extraction from multiview calcium imaging datasets

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 07 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03215-6 DeepWonder3D is a pipeline for neuronal extraction from volumetric calcium imaging data acquired with a variety of one-photon or two-photon microscopy modalities.
